claim_ceiling: One prospectively bound real owner/project/inquiry episode for agency, trust, privacy and burden observation only. No positive repeat-use value, retention, accumulated-history benefit, product direction, network value, willingness to pay, market demand, release, cutover or owner admission.
exact_reentry: On a later genuine Task-F work opportunity, preregister before outcome; allow voluntary reuse/bypass/abandonment; collect explicit post-use usefulness, next-action, history-benefit, burden-acceptability, privacy and trust/control judgments; add comparator and independent review where causal accumulation is claimed; rerun the same frozen instrument and return to web.synthesize -> web.steer.
